entries.claim: The new quoted-value scan stops at the first closing byte sequence it sees, so a quoted flag value that legitimately contains an escaped quote is only partially redacted.
entries.failure_scenario: An input like `--token "ab\"cd"` (or the JSON-escaped form `--token \"ab\\\"cd\"`) matches the first `"` inside the value, redacts only the prefix, and leaves the remainder of the secret visible.
